summary: I found no problems, so I am approving this change. It makes `workspace.previewFile` return the UTF-8 content for text files. `FilePane` now passes that content straight to the editors, so it no longer makes a second `readFile` request, and autosave writes saved content into the `workspace-preview` cache. The protocol version moves to 29 and the server still accepts 28. A 29 client therefore refuses a 28-only server, which would send previews without `content`, while older clients can still call `readFile`. The temp e2e tests confirm that opening a file makes exactly one `previewFile` request and no `readFile` request, that the content is right for markdown, plain text and TypeScript files, and that edits are saved. The only changed executable line is covered, and all temp runs pass.
